hooks.prompt: Context: $ARGUMENTS. FIRST: Determine if you are currently operating as a GRADER (running dimension reviews, computing scores, generating grade reports). If you are NOT in a grading role (e.g. you are an engineer, tester, or debugger), respond {"ok": true} immediately — this restriction only applies to grading sessions. If you ARE the grader, check: the file being written must be a report output file (.md, .json, .html, .txt). Writing source code files (.c, .h, .py, .conf, .cmake, .overlay, .dts, .dtsi, .sh) is FORBIDDEN for the grader — show fix suggestions as code examples inside the report instead. Respond {"ok": true} if the write is allowed, or {"ok": false, "reason": "BLOCKED: Grader must not write source files"} if blocked.

Context: $ARGUMENTS. FIRST: Determine if you are currently operating as a GRADER (running dimension reviews, computing scores, generating grade reports). If you are NOT in a grading role (e.g. you are an engineer, tester, or debugger), respond {"ok": true} immediately — this restriction only applies to grading sessions. If you ARE the grader, check: graders must ONLY run read-only analysis commands. BLOCK: rm/delete operations, git push/commit/write operations, west flash, sed -i, shell output redirection to source files, make install. ALLOW: cat, head, grep, find, ls, wc, stat, git log/diff/status/show, west build (for analysis), cppcheck, lizard, cloc, size, readelf, objdump. Respond {"ok": true} if the command is safe for a grader, or {"ok": false, "reason": "BLOCKED: Graders must only run read-only commands"} if blocked.

Context: $ARGUMENTS. FIRST: Determine if you are currently operating as a GRADER (running dimension reviews, computing scores, generating grade reports). If you are NOT in a grading role (e.g. you are an engineer, tester, or debugger), respond {"ok": true} immediately — this validation only applies to grading sessions. If you ARE the grader, validate the report output: (1) File is NOT inside a submission directory (submissions are read-only), (2) All numeric scores are in 0-100 range with supporting evidence, (3) No qualitative-only judgments without data/metrics, (4) If the file contains dimension scores, each has clear justification. Respond {"ok": true} if all checks pass, or {"ok": false, "reason": "specific issue"} if validation fails.

hooks.description: Launch static analysis tools after successful west build

hooks.prompt:
Context: $ARGUMENTS. FIRST: Determine if this session involved grading a Zephyr codebase (running dimension reviewers, computing scores, generating grade reports). If NO grading work was performed in this session, respond {"ok": true} immediately — this hook only applies to grading sessions.

If grading WAS performed, verify:

For Single Submission Mode:
1. All 9 dimensions scored (0-100) or explicitly marked N/A with justification
2. Aggregate score computed using the weighted formula
3. All 3 output formats generated: Markdown report, JSON structured data, HTML formatted report
4. Every dimension score includes supporting evidence (metrics, tool outputs, code examples)
5. LLM-evaluated dimensions (Clarity, Documentation, Error Handling) have confidence levels assigned

For A/B Comparison Mode, additionally verify:
6. Both submissions scored independently with full dimension breakdowns
7. Side-by-side comparison table showing dimension-by-dimension differences
8. Recommendation with clear reasoning about which submission is superior

Respond {"ok": true} if all verification checks pass.
Respond {"ok": false, "reason": "specific missing element"} if work is incomplete.
hooks.description: Verify all grading dimensions scored and reports generated
